summary: The exact candidate correctly enables the already-present Mooncake index batching by default and passes focused and independent boundary tests. This is credible partial hardening, but it does not verify or fully resolve the original GLM-5.2 FP8, H100, multi-node DSA/HiCache/HiSparse/DeepEP failure. Its report overstates the result as fixed and incorrectly treats stale upstream PR prose as proof that the merged implementation used or validated a global 1024 default.

tests.what_was_measured: The base's opt-in batching implementation passed 5 tests and 3 subtests, while a direct prepared-source import measured the default as 0.
The candidate regression and batching suite passed 6 tests and 3 subtests using modules imported from /job/repo.
Independent 1023/1024/1025/2049-index boundaries, ordering and byte coverage, explicit-zero legacy behavior, and nonzero failure short-circuiting.
Explicit legacy disable and positive override remain functional.
40 related disaggregation timeout, cleanup, and deferred-release tests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The available device is one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, not the reported H100 fleet. No relevant multi-node Mooncake/RDMA or GLM-5.2 fixture was available; an unrelated GPU smoke would not validate the issue.

remaining_counterexamples: The original glm5.2-fp8 deployment was not reproduced before or after the candidate; upstream PR 32758 discussion explicitly says its failure was not reproduced on FP8.
The original 2-node prefill and 4-node/32-rank decode topology with H100, Mooncake/RDMA, DSA, HiCache, HiSparse, and DeepEP remains untested.
A source-issue follow-up reports freezing specifically when --moe-a2a-backend deepep is enabled; changing Mooncake transfer batch size does not independently establish that this path is fixed.
The 1024 global default was measured on GLM-5.2-NVFP4 and its per-index byte size; safety and efficacy for other models and KV layouts were not independently demonstrated.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was available; the report used NVIDIA H100 hardware.
GLM-5.2 weights and Mooncake/RDMA peers were unavailable.
No full model, semantic accuracy, or distributed execution claim is made.
No native code changed and repository-environment.json lists no native artifact, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
